title: Shopping starts with AI, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); HP launched Experience AI; TikTok, Gap and Walmart added AI shopping. Omdia: PC shipments -21% in 3Q26; Prime days hit $9.86B (+8.5%), electronics +85%.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream path to purchase, and rivals are building for it
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; HP launched Experience AI; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. We should benchmark our search, content and checkout against these.

points.headline: PC demand is cooling just as memory costs squeeze AI PC pricing
points.detail: Omdia: global PC shipments fell 21% in 3Q26 as pull-forward demand faded; DigiTimes flags memory costs. We should plan holiday promotions and inventory for softer volume.

points.headline: Rivals push premium AI laptops through new price points and channels
points.detail: Microsoft priced Surface Laptop Ultra at $2,599; Nvidia RTX Spark laptops opened for pre-order; Apple readies a touchscreen MacBook. We should check our premium AI lineup.

points.headline: Record holiday forecasts meet shopper budget worries, with Prime events setting the pace
points.detail: Adobe: Prime days drove $9.86B (+8.5% YoY), electronics +85% vs September; holiday online sales forecast $275.1B (+6.7%). ICSC: half fear gift costs. Plan deals and inventory early.
